user.title: Inverter Charge Night – Entities
user.description: Step 1 of 4: Choose the operation mode and the inverter, forecast and battery entities. Night Charge charges the battery from the grid during the time window; Morning Discharge discharges it before sunrise to make room for solar production.

data_description.name: Name for this integration instance
data_description.operation_mode: Night Charge: charges battery from grid overnight. Morning Discharge: discharges battery before sunrise to make room for solar.
data_description.kostal_min_soc_entity: Select the Kostal number entity that controls minimum SOC. It also identifies this integration instance, so each inverter can only be configured once.
data_description.kostal_grid_charge_switch: Select the Kostal switch entity that enables/disables grid charging
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: PV forecast for the NEXT DAY (e.g. sensor.solcast_forecast_tomorrow). Used automatically when the window runs before midnight (evening). Also used as fallback if today's forecast entity is not configured.
data_description.pv_forecast_today_entity: Optional: TODAY's PV forecast entity (e.g. sensor.solcast_forecast_today). Used automatically when the window runs after midnight. Falls back to the main forecast entity if not set.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Select the sensor that shows current battery state of charge (%)

time_soc.title: Inverter Charge Night – Time & SOC
time_soc.description: Step 2 of 4: Set the time window in which the integration is active and the SOC limits. The calculated target SOC is always kept between the minimum and the maximum.

data.default_min_soc: Default Min SOC to restore at end time

data_description.start_time: Time when the window should start. Hour:minute, 24-hour format. The window may span midnight (e.g., 22:00 to 05:59).
data_description.end_time: Time when the window should end and settings are reset. Hour:minute, 24-hour format. The window may span midnight.
data_description.user_min_soc: Minimum allowed SOC percentage (0-100). Target SOC will not go below this.
data_description.user_max_soc: Maximum allowed SOC percentage (0-100). Target SOC will not go above this.
data_description.default_min_soc: Min SOC value to restore at end time (typically 8% for Kostal)
data_description.forecast_error_margin: Safety margin for forecast uncertainty (%). Added to forecast before calculation.

power.title: Inverter Charge Night – Charge Power
power.description: Step 3 of 4: Set the charge power limits and the optional entities used to control and measure charging. Leave the optional entities empty if your inverter does not expose them.

data.charge_power_entity: Battery Max AC Charge Limit Entity (optional)

data_description.min_charge_power_w: Minimum charge power allowed for AUTO mode (W).
data_description.max_charge_power_w: Maximum charge power allowed for AUTO mode (W).
data_description.absolute_max_charge_power_w: Absolute max charge power (AC+DC). Applied during AC charging and reset afterward. Optional if you use the AC limit entity; requires the entity below when set.
data_description.absolute_max_charge_power_entity: Optional: number entity to set absolute max charge power (AC+DC). Requires the value above when set.
data_description.charge_power_entity: Optional: number entity used to set the max AC charge limit (W or kW). Use this OR the AC+DC max entity.
data_description.charge_power_sent_entity: Optional: sensor with power sent to battery (W or kW).
data_description.charge_power_received_entity: Optional: sensor with power received by battery (W or kW).
data_description.auto_efficient_charge: If enabled, integration searches for the most efficient charge power between min and max and stops when found. Requires the AC charge limit entity and both charge power sensors.
data_description.force_discharge_switch: Optional: switch entity to force battery discharge to grid (e.g. via Kostal Modbus). Turned on during active discharge, turned off when target SOC reached.

advanced.title: Inverter Charge Night – Advanced
advanced.description: Step 4 of 4: Fine-tune the update interval and command delay, restrict the active date range and select a backup mode entity. The defaults are fine for most installations.

data_description.update_interval: How often the coordinator should refresh data (seconds, default 900)
data_description.command_delay: Delay between min SOC and grid charge commands (seconds, default 0.1)
data_description.active_start_date: Optional: only run between this date and end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to always allow.
data_description.active_end_date: Optional: only run between start date and this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to always allow.
data_description.backup_mode_entity: Optional: entity that indicates backup/island mode. If active, integration will not change min SOC or grid charge.
